description: The Acquire step (plan §20.1, §12.4; session D, owner 2026-10-18) and the Release step after read errors, each run alone with a StepContext the harness builds, like plan-steps.cases.json (request, probe, outputs, config, drives, libraries, volumes, reserveFails and the expectations). The job is 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001; LibraryPort.stagingDirectory gives <library path>/.bromelia/staging/<job> and makes it. Given also: tree [paths under the staging folder that exist before the step; folders are made for every parent]; checkpoint (what ICheckpointer.saved gives; a fingerprint "probe" is Probe's); outputs[].readErrors (the StepOutput's read errors); makemkv.runs, taken in order by every Makemkv call the step makes (listing, rip, backup), each {listing (a generated listing: what a listing run reads), files (rip: names made in the destination; backup: paths made under the destination folder), image (backup: the destination is made as a file, 32769 zero bytes then header), header, produced (RunOutcome.produced; default: the files of a rip, the top-level names of a backup folder, the destination's name for an image), status (success | errors | failed | cancelled; default success), error {code, params} (the outcome's error), exitCode, readErrors [texts], abandoned, cancel (the job's token is cancelled before the call returns), notice (MakemkvNotice), isolationWarning / transcriptProblem / settingsProblem {code, params}, robot [lines given to the run's sink]}; a call with no run left fails with internal.unexpected. Calls are recorded in order: 'invocation <selection or -> minLength=<makemkv.minLengthSeconds or null>' (MakemkvSetup), 'listing <source>', 'rip <source> <title> <destination>', 'backup <source> <decrypt> <destination>', 'reserve <volume> <path> <need> <free>', 'checkpoint <the saved checkpoint {kind, fingerprint, titles, backup, readErrors}: the canonical encoding on one line, as JobLog writes it; Probe's fingerprint as "probe">', 'eject <device>'; sources are disc:N, iso:<path>, file:<path>. Expect also: tree [the files under the staging folder afterwards, relative, sorted; an empty folder ends in /] (exactly); fs [the FileSystem calls that change something, in order: 'write <path>', 'sync <path>', 'syncDirectory <path>', 'remove <path>', 'rename <from> <to>'] (exactly); json {name: the file's JSON under the staging folder; "probe": the listing Probe read, Listing.encode}; readErrors (StepReport.readErrors); resources {drives, acquisition, libraryWrites}; resumes {resumability, checkpoint (the kind of checkpoint the step resumes from by itself after a restart, Step.resumeCheckpoint)}. H3b: a run may give debugLog {path, text} (RunOutcome.debugLog; text, when given, is that file's content); expect jobFiles {name: the text of that file in the job's folder /data/jobs/<job>, or null when there is none}: after each run MakeMKV's debug log is added to makemkv-debug.txt after a line '==== <its path> after $ makemkvcon <info | mkv | backup>' (none when it is empty or missing).
